visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, wavy brown hair sits patiently as a makeup artist's hand applies eyeshadow with a thin brush. She has a serene facial expression and is wearing a white, heavily beaded off-the-shoulder wedding gown. The background is a plain, light-colored studio wall. (2) The shot widens to show a stylist in black clothing standing behind the seated model, adjusting her hair with professional care. The stylist's hands move through the hair while a utility belt with spray bottles is visible. Studio lighting stands and photography equipment appear in the background. (3) A wide shot captures the model standing in the center of the studio in her full, voluminous gown. The stylist is crouched on the floor, carefully spreading out the long lace train of the dress. The lighting is bright and even across the white studio space. (4) In a close-up pose, the model looks into the camera, touching her neck and the floral details on her dress straps. Her makeup is refined with soft pink tones. The gown features intricate beading and floral appliqués that catch the bright studio light. (5) The perspective shifts to an overhead view as the model lies down on the soft fabric of her gown. Her hair is spread out elegantly around her head. She poses with her hands near her chest, looking upwards with a romantic and ethereal gaze. (6) A full-body shot shows the model standing and slowly swaying her large skirt from side to side. She holds the edges of the white fabric with her hands, demonstrating the dress's movement. The background remains a clean, professional white studio environment.
